name: Staked FRAX
oneLiner: sFRAX is Frax's legacy-FRAX savings vault; protocol-funded rewards accrue to shares redeemable for pro-rata FRAX, without a guaranteed yield.
collateral: Legacy FRAX held by the StakedFrax vault, including protocol-funded FRAX rewards; Frax reserve and yield-source exposure remains upstream
pegMechanism: Deposit legacy FRAX to mint ERC-4626 shares and redeem for the current pro-rata FRAX amount, without a local withdrawal fee or cooldown. Protocol-funded rewards follow seven-day cycles and an administrator-set distribution cap; synchronization is permissionless and the IORB yield target is not guaranteed.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The exact Ethereum deployment 0xa663b02cf0a4b149d2ad41910cb81e23e1c41c32 is the fixed StakedFrax ERC-4626 implementation over legacy FRAX at 0x853d955acef822db058eb8505911ed77f175b99e. The holder has an operational pro-rata FRAX claim plus linear protocol-funded rewards, not direct title to Frax reserve assets. Local custody and reward accounting require a protocol-position review distinct from the parent. At Ethereum block 26197388 (2026-10-15T10:42:47Z), deployed bytecode matches the complete verified source and the implementation slot is zero. Creation receipt 0xecd4ab27bc3b4c300b11405fc6a156ee316ad3f4c24f63130cbcbc49ae6bef55 at block 18378085 independently confirms deployment at 2023-10-18T15:19:11Z. This deployment date is the product launch lower bound, not issuer founding or parent-token launch.

notices.title: Legacy sFRAX and newer sfrxUSD use different contracts
notices.message: Frax's historical sFRAX address table includes contracts on Fraxtal, Mode, Sei and X Layer that now identify as sfrxUSD. This listing retains verified legacy sFRAX shares and representations. Bridged balances carry separate bridge controls; the direct FRAX withdrawal described here applies to the native Ethereum vault.

notices.title: Historical Polygon zkEVM deployment is excluded
notices.message: Polygon zkEVM stopped producing blocks on July 3, 2026. The historical sFRAX deployment there is excluded from this listing's active deployment census: archived token balances do not establish a current transfer or bridge exit. Polygon's recovery process has separate eligibility restrictions and does not establish an executable sFRAX redemption.
